description: Use for PPK workplace pensions: participants, participation rate, net assets, average account and fees. PPK (Pracownicze Plany Kapitałowe), the Polish auto-enrolment workplace pension programme, from the monthly PFR Portal PPK bulletin (PPK Register kept by PFR): net assets of target date funds, active accounts, participants, employers running PPK, participation rate, average management fee, number of financial institutions and finwire_ppk_avg_account (Średnie konto PPK finwire: net assets per active account), with monthly history.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

name: get_ppk_stats
title: PPK (Employee Capital Plans) statistics
